title: Lok Prahari v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Lok Prahari v. Union of India, (2018) 4 SCC 699
content.facts: The Court considered statutory and constitutional questions concerning public accountability and high public office.
questionsBeforeCourt: What is the constitutional basis for accountability of public functionaries?
content.ratioDecidendi: Public office is subject to constitutional accountability, transparency and lawful institutional controls; judicial review may protect those requirements without replacing the statutory authority.
content.holding: The Court applied constitutional accountability principles.
content.relevance: Use as supplementary authority for public-functionary accountability, alongside the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013.
